modmenu.descriptionTranslation.catcraft_: CatCraft command, navigation, staff, and chat companion.
key.ccmc.gui.title: CatCraft Companion Settings
key.ccmc.gui.missingConfigLib: Cloth Config is required to configure CatCraft Companion.
key.ccmc.general.Timestamp.Pattern.@Tool: Timestamp format. & is the Minecraft color-code prefix; the default uses a subtle dark gray. Available values include {hour}, {minute}, and {second}.
key.ccmc.general.Timestamp.CopyToChatBar: Click a timestamp to copy the message with or without formatting.
key.ccmc.general.MessageStacking.MaxRepe: Maximum repeat counter retained by CatCraft Companion for repeated-message handling.
key.ccmc.general.StoredChatLines.@Toolti: Maximum number of chat lines and timestamp message records CatCraft Companion keeps available.
key.ccmc.catcraft.PlayerClickMode.@Toolt: normal = click a player name; ctrl = Ctrl+click; disabled = leave player-name clicks unchanged.
key.ccmc.texts.copy.launch: Click to open message copy options.
key.ccmc.texts.copy.title: Copy Message
key.ccmc.general.ChatIntegrationMode.@To: auto = yield overlapping chat features when a supported external chat processor is detected; ccc = force CatCraft Companion timestamps/history; external = disable CatCraft Companion chat processing. Staff tools remain active in all modes. The legacy ccmc value is also accepted.
key.ccmc.catcraft.PlayerRank.@Tooltip: Your CatCraft player/store rank. Member, Cat, Leopard, Cheetah, Jaguar, Tiger, and Lion are cumulative for command filtering.
key.ccmc.catcraft.StaffRole.@Tooltip: Your CatCraft staff role. Staff commands are filtered independently from your player rank; Developer is treated as a separate technical role.
